name: flamework-test-place
description: The Roblox place Flamework's in-place test suite runs in, against this repository's own package builds.

scripts.test: rbxtsc && rojo build -o place.rbxl && lune run scripts/fabricate-original.luau --if-missing && flamework-test test place.rbxl
scripts.test:cloud: rbxtsc && rojo build -o place.rbxl && lune run scripts/fabricate-original.luau --if-missing && flamework-test test place.rbxl --cloud
